title: Confirmed H5N1 dairy cattle herds by state (cumulative since March 2024)

source.name: HPAI confirmed cases in livestock
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS)

notes: Cumulative confirmed H5N1 detections in dairy cattle herds by state, as of the ~959-herd national milestone in January 2025 (APHIS data, via UK government outbreak assessment reporting). The national cumulative total continued climbing past 1,000 herds across 17-19 states by April 2025.
